import hashlib, os, zipfile
z = r'C:\gw1-stage\scratch\garnet-0.8.2-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip'
data = open(z, 'rb').read()
print('zip_sha256=' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + f' bytes={len(data)} (the zip is kept outside the bundle)')
want = [l.split()[0].decode() for l in open(r'C:\gw1-stage\20260924-1205-NUCBOX_M2PRO_S\streams\L07-SHA256SUMS.v0.8.2', 'rb').read().splitlines() if l.endswith(b'garnet-0.8.2-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip')]
print('SHA256SUMS_entry=' + (want[0] if want else 'ABSENT'))
print('zip_matches_SHA256SUMS=' + str(bool(want) and want[0] == hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()))
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as zf:
    for i in zf.infolist(): print(f'entry {i.filename} size={i.file_size}')
    exe = zf.read('garnet.exe')
print('zip_garnet_exe_sha256=' + hashlib.sha256(exe).hexdigest())

argv:
import glob, html, re, sys
paths = sorted(glob.glob(r'C:\gw1-stage\20260924-1205-NUCBOX_M2PRO_S\streams\M03-installer-main-hint.*'))
raw = b''.join(open(p, 'rb').read() for p in paths)
err = open(r'C:\gw1-stage\20260924-1205-NUCBOX_M2PRO_S\streams\M03-installer-main-hint.stderr', 'rb').read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
text = html.unescape(''.join(re.findall(r'<S S="Error">(.*?)</S>', err, re.S))).replace('_x000D__x000A_', '\n')
needle = '--tag v0.8.2'
found = needle.encode() in raw or needle in text.replace('\n', '')
print('streams=' + ','.join(p.rsplit(chr(92), 1)[-1] for p in paths))
print(f'contains {needle!r}: {found}')
print('--- decoded view of the CLIXML error records in the stderr stream (derived; the raw stream is authoritative)')
print(text.rstrip())
sys.exit(0 if found else 1)
steps.display: python -I -c <decode M03 CLIXML error text; exit 1 unless it contains --tag v0.8.2>
